caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden panel with a brown colored fill and dark brown outlined vertical grooves running parallel to its longer sides. The main view shows the front face of the panel, with two sets of narrow vertical stripes spaced evenly across its width, creating three broader sections. To the right of the panel, an upward-pointing double-headed arrow is labeled with a vertical dimension of "6' 8''", and at the bottom a horizontal double-headed arrow is labeled "3' 5 1/2''". Below this is a cross-sectional view of the panel, showing the profile of the top edge with precise outlines, indicating a tongue and groove joint, and detailing texture with lines. The cross-section is annotated with the horizontal measurements "1 1/2" on the left and "10 1/2" on the right. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holt" in the bottom right corner. The rest of the background is an off-white, unmarked surface.
title: Original Inside Door to Sacristy
